test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given matrix carefully and select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 12
 7
 70
 
 

 15
 6
 78
 
 

 11
 9
 ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Row 1: (12 - 2) × 7 = 10 × 7 = 70
 
• Row 2: (15 - 2) × 6 = 13 × 6 = 78

Similarly,

 
• Row 3: (11 - 2) × 9 = 9 × 9 = 81

Hence, '**81**' is the correct answer.
